normal_transfer.derived_from_XML: R1/R2=10M divider; U6 follower; R3..R6=82k weighted node; U7 follower; R24=330/R25=1k divider
normal_transfer.corner_limits: All8resistors independently±1%; ideal followers; fixed VDD=3.3V; excludes opamp offset/bias,ADC/reference error, temperature and dynamic effects.

findings.finding: Original C13=10nF connected directly to U7IN+ atCV_FILTER. R7 was upstream and could not limit initial C13 discharge into U7 during a fast3V3 collapse.
findings.agreed_fix: Move C13pin1 toCV_AFFINE, leaving R7 between C13/CV_AFFINE and D3/U7IN+ atCV_FILTER; noR26 or firmware coefficient change.

conditional_capacitor_bound.normal_precharge_conditions: CV±5V, VDD3.0..3.6V, R1..R6±1%, idealU6, no other external impulse
conditional_capacitor_bound.conclusion: Below10mA for this explicitly bounded charge-discharge path; not a proof of arbitrary transient pin voltages.

findings.finding: The approximately0.25V powered-off result is a conditional passive steady-DC current-budget screen, not a datasheet guarantee of U7 unpowered output behavior or all partial-power states.
conditional_DC_assumptions: Other supply sources inactive, capacitors discharged, stableGND, no SWD/probe backpower
All relevant injected current paths included; no claim of valid opamp operation below1.8V
findings.interpretation: The R1 contribution is upstream of R3 in the ordinary signal path and is not normally independent; adding it is a conservative allowance, not a predicted off-state current. A fully unpowered device does not imply every protected/floating rail is held at0V.
findings.remaining: Check U7 individual/differential input terminal limits below1.8V, negative ADC excursions, rail absorption, and actual off-state current; do not assume an unpowered follower tracks or stays atGND.

findings.finding: TLV755P output capacitors can remain charged while+5V input collapses. Exported netlist has no explicit reverse-current bypass/protector between3V3 and5V.
findings.basis: TI TLV755P§7.1.4 identifies VOUT>VIN+0.3V as an absolute-maximum violation and discusses output-capacitor/input-collapse reverse current.
findings.required_scope: Measure/resolve fast5V collapse and partial-power sequencing independently of the small CV steady-DC budget; the resistor current budget does not cover energy stored on supply capacitors.

findings.finding: Retained marker correctly blocks MCU warm/BOR reset while the backup domain survives. It cannot alone block a TPS2552-1 supply-only restart before FAULT is observed.
findings.basis: TPS2552-1 overcurrent FAULT is deglitched (7.5ms typical); cycling its supply clears its latch. A5 has no separate5V-valid monitor;3V3 and MCU may persist across a short5V event.
findings.required_wording: Guaranteed software behavior applies after an observed fault or classified MCU reset under the documented input/ISR contract. Test5V-only sag/recovery, retained-domain BOR and complete-domain loss separately. Do not claim no retry for every partial-power transient.

findings.finding: Actual XML aligns with firmware PA0ADC,PA2/3ordered mode bits,PA4FAULTlow,PA5highenable viaNPN,PA6/7TIM3 outputs, externalpullups and reset-safe pulldowns. The A5 inversegain10.64 and ratio100/133 match.
findings.remaining: Factory programming must verify main-flash boot/SWD/NRST and record BOR option-byte configuration; firmware does not silently change option bytes.

findings.finding: Electronics integration reports that the right identical leaf is mounted end-for-end: wire indexD1..D4 runs opposite the left leaf physical vertical direction. Current firmware uses uniform pixels within each chain, so its defaults are unaffected. A future pattern that aligns vertical positions must map right index=3-left index. This is an assembly-coordinate note, not a GPIO or chain-order error.
The two DIN roots differ. Each D4 DOUT is unconnected; the inter-leaf bridge carries the independent right stream, not the left D4 output.

actual_paths.left: PA6/TIM3_CH1 → U5.A1/B1 → R14 → controller.J3.3 → left.J1.3 → D1,D2,D3,D4
actual_paths.right: PA7/TIM3_CH2 → U5.A2/B2 → R15 → controller.J3.4 → left.J1.4 → left.J2.3 → right.J1.3 → D1,D2,D3,D4

findings.returned_branch: Cable2 pin4 carries the left stream from left.J2.4 to right.J1.4 and right.J2.3. It is an unloaded branch, not a connection to right D1 DIN. Right.J2 remains unconnected externally; its pin4 is a short local branch of the right stream.

findings.finding: Cable1 and the controller/left input contacts carry both leaves. Cable2 carries the right leaf. Neither chain has a separate power limiter; a detected shared-bus fault blanks both.
findings.required_scope: Validate the actual shared cable/connector load, voltage drop, DIN edges and physical pin map. The 20% code cap, configured current-limit threshold, and 1A AWG28 connector rating are not a hardware qualification.
findings.mechanical_routing_status: Current saved cable/ribbon routes are rejected: 16 conditional interferences per variant; controller-to-leaf sampled bend minima about1.07–1.53mm, leaf-link about0.20–0.28mm, power about1.05mm. Complete harness routing remains unresolved; only rigid-part geometry cleared the modeled interference checks.

bridge_followup.power_path: U4.OUT/VLED → controller.J3.2 → cable1 → left.J1.2; left.J2.2 → cable2 → right.J1.2. Pin1 carries common GND. All eight LED VDD and GND nodes trace correctly; +5V before U4 is a separate net.

current_limit_screen.source: TI TPS255x §8.5.1 equations (1)-(3), with resistor tolerance per §9.2.1.2.3
current_limit_screen.interpretation: This is the configured DC current-limit threshold range, not an instantaneous-current bound or a full cable/PCB thermal qualification. Stored VLED capacitance and short-circuit response can create transients outside it.

bridge_followup.connector_rating_context: JST SH specifies 1.0A with AWG28. That source rating does not establish the exact purchased third-party harness gauge, crimps, bend life, or voltage drop; qualify the actual cable assembly and populated board.
bridge_followup.firmware_alignment: PA6/7 still feed the intended independent four-pixel chains. PA0 CV, ordered PA2/3 mode bits, PA4 low fault, PA5 high NPN enable, and TP1..5 nets +3V3/GND/SWDIO/SWCLK/NRST remain aligned. The firmware documents contain no stale J4/pin4-NC connector claim.
bridge_followup.ADC_and_reset_scope: C13 remains upstream of R7 at CV_AFFINE. U7 and the 330ohm/1kohm divider are unchanged; the A5 ADC transfer remains (100/133)*(VDD/2+CV/8). Earlier partial-power, LDO reverse-current, and fault/reset limitation findings remain open.
